narrative:
No. 60 Operational Training Unit was formed at RAF High Ercall, Shropshire, in May 1943, training night intruder crews on de Havilland Mosquitoes. The unit suffered multiple training losses across a wide area including Shropshire, Wales, and Northern Ireland.

One documented loss involved Mosquito II HJ650, flown by F/O Jan Antoni Liblikmaa (Estonian-born, age 27) with Sgt Jerzy Hara (navigator, age 20). At 13:04 hrs, HJ650 was involved in a mid-air collision with Mosquito II HJ703, piloted by Flight Lieutenant Barnett of 36 Course, also from 60 OTU. HJ703 made a successful single-engine landing back at RAF High Ercall but HJ650 crashed in the West Bromwich area with the loss of both crew members. An ambulance was sent to recover the bodies and removed them to the mortuary at RAF Halfpenny Green.
community_connection: The memorial is maintained by High Ercall Parish Council.
